ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the central and medial regions with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized on the distal lateral sections of both lobes. Approximate ratio of 75% low-intensity to 25% high-intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches on the outer third of both the left and right lobes. The left lobe (viewer perspective) contains a white region with internal low-intensity striations and mottling. The right lobe contains a similar high-contrast patch concentrated at the tip. Small, high-intensity focal spots are scattered across the dark central fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the fluke center, partially obscured by high-intensity water spray/turbulance at the vertex, preventing precise angle calculation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent, irregular serrations with low-to-medium pixel amplitude along the entire visible trailing edge, with more pronounced jagged peaks occurring at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature on the outer margins of the lobes, tapering to acute points at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Several small, isolated white circular spots on the dark pigment are visible in the mid-lobe regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization on both distal lobe tips; scattered white circular scarring across the dark ventral surface.
